title: Gender Bias of LLM in Economics: An Existentialism Perspective
reasoning: The paper extensively uses a philosophical and ethical framework (existentialism, citing Foucault and Sartre) to analyze bias. Furthermore, it incorporates an evaluation of religious traditions, divine doctrine, and theological perspectives as part of the societal structures that contribute to the persistence of gender bias, even citing specific biblical verses (Ephesians 5:22-24) in its references.
